answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using remote hardware attestation, requiring each agent to run inside certified secure enclaves. Attackers incur the scarce cost of purchasing physical silicon, verified across an orchard of nodes. Identity spoofing drops to a nadir because software clones cannot extract credentials fused into tamper-resistant onyx dies. However, this approach trusts centralized chip manufacturers and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
